source: GitHub issue search and issue view via gh CLI
claim_boundary: These public issues are context for feedback-only outreach. They are not evidence that maintainers want StateBind Guard, and they do not authorize a code PR or CI adoption proposal.
posting_gate: Use current issues only to make the feedback question specific.
Do not comment on another issue unless the comment adds direct maintainer value.
Do not present StateBind Guard as a fix for a target repository issue without a concrete patch or maintainer request.
Preserve the human final-review gate before posting any public comment.

targets.current_read: Recent open issues show durable execution, message-history serialization, provider-valid histories, and state-loss boundaries are active project concerns. This strengthens the relevance of a narrow feedback request, but it still does not justify an adoption pitch.
targets.draft_context: Before writing this, I also checked current public issue context, including #5731 and #5721. That made the executable handoff/state-binding question feel plausibly related, but I am not treating those issues as a request to adopt StateBind Guard.

evidence_items.title: [roundtrip-sweep] _clean_message_history: conversation_id and metadata lost on round-trip
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The reported boundary is exactly a durable resume/history case where identifiers remain visible but state needed for correlation is lost.

evidence_items.title: [roundtrip-sweep] ModelResponsePart: `ToolReturnPart` with `part_kind='tool-return'` missing from discriminated union - breaks message history round-trip
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: Tool result identity survives in the narrative but fails the typed round-trip boundary, which is close to executable binding integrity.

evidence_items.title: Expose public `message_history` validator for provider-valid histories
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The issue asks for a reusable structural validator over message histories; StateBind Guard is adjacent but should be framed as external audit feedback, not a replacement.

evidence_items.title: History and Message (De)Serialization hooks to prevent hitting Temporal payload size limit
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The discussion is about durable execution payload/history boundaries, showing the repo has real state-continuation pressure beyond generic agent instructions.

targets.current_read: Recent and historical issues show active maintainer attention to RunState, handoff history, HITL resume, and active-run lifecycle boundaries. This supports a cautious feedback request, but the relationship bar is high and the ask should stay narrow.
targets.draft_context: Before writing this, I also checked current public issue context, including #3319 and #3004. They made the handoff-history/RunState binding question feel plausibly related, but I am not suggesting a behavior change or default SDK integration.

evidence_items.title: Nested handoff history flattening drops multiline and structured content
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The issue is an explicit handoff-history integrity boundary where content shape is not preserved across chained handoffs.

evidence_items.title: HITL resume drops tool output when parallel calls mix approval-gated and non-approval tools
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The failure involves resume-time binding between a tool call and the output that must still be sent, which is close to StateBind Guard's role-to-handle boundary.

evidence_items.title: RunState approval restore accepts invalid decision shapes
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The issue concerns deserialization integrity of approval decisions, a state-resume boundary with safety implications.

evidence_items.title: Feature Request: Enhanced Run Lifecycle Management - Interrupt and Update Active Runs
evidence_items.statebind_relevance: The discussion asks for explicit active-run handles and step/state continuation, which is adjacent to executable handoff contracts.
